default.assertion: Use a controlled fixture and verify effect; not a boot test

policy.assertion: Requires visible LED observation; never change live outputs during boot tests
Creates SD images; verify file and view image using a controlled target
Needs a known IR source/target or recorded fixture; do not transmit or edit dictionary at boot
Use an isolated program; start/stop and queue consumption affect live behavior
Creates SD files; verify a controlled artifact and preserve user files
Needs an existing environment snapshot; must not fabricate cached values
Use an isolated saved VM; never replace or clear the live startup program for testing
Read a specified directory without mutation
Can interrupt Neo connectivity; test only with an independent recovery link
Use a valid Linux fixture; file/audio/display/IR effects need verification and may affect live threads

TIME_RESET.assertion: Reset changes program timestamps; test only in an isolated VM

SELF_TEST.assertion: Inspect cached boot evidence; never recursively probe itself

STORAGE_STATUS.assertion: SD mounted; no test file written

SD_READ.assertion: Read existing Iris metadata file without writing SD

ADC_READ.assertion: Configured ADC channel reads within driver's range; no calibrated light fixture

LIGHT_READ.assertion: Photoresistor ADC API returns; light-change response needs external observation

TEMP_HUMIDITY_READ.assertion: DHT11 pulse decode, checksum and measurement range pass

ULTRASONIC_READ.assertion: Single bounded ranging pulse receives an echo

DISTANCE_MM.assertion: Distance wrapper measures a valid echo

MIC_LEVEL.assertion: I2S produces samples; zero loudness can be valid silence

MIC_ABOVE.assertion: Threshold wrapper receives valid mic samples

WIFI_STATUS.assertion: Wi-Fi API callable; connection may still be pending

BLE_STATUS.assertion: BLE transport initialized; connected peer is not required

VM_LAST_STATUS.assertion: VM persistence status callable without replacing program

SEQUENCE_BUSY.assertion: Busy bit accessible without changing sequence

SEQUENCE_QUEUE_SIZE.assertion: Queue size accessible without consuming events

ULTRASONIC_CHANGE_STATUS.assertion: Detector status readable; no event consumed

LIGHT_CHANGE_STATUS.assertion: Detector status readable; no event consumed

MIC_RISE_STATUS.assertion: Detector status readable; no event consumed

IR_THREAD_STATUS.assertion: IR capture thread status readable; no capture started

NEO_IR_STATUS.assertion: Neo IR driver available; remote press not tested

NEO_DISPLAY_STATUS.assertion: Neo display worker status readable; visible pixels need observation

WIFI_SCAN.assertion: Scan may affect Wi-Fi dongle traffic; do not run automatically

WIFI_RSSI.assertion: Requires WIFI_SCAN results; cached RSSI must retain acquisition timestamp

BLE_SCAN.assertion: Needs nearby advertisements and may affect the command link

WIFI_CREDENTIALS_SET.assertion: Changes persistent credentials; never auto-test or log password

BLE_PEER_SET.assertion: Changes persistent command peer; never auto-test

SD_DELETE.assertion: Delete only a named disposable diagnostic file after confirmation

VM_DELETE_SAVED.assertion: Delete only a disposable diagnostic VM, never runtime_last

VM_LAST_CLEAR.assertion: Clears persistent startup state; never auto-test

GPIO_AUDIT.assertion: GPIO diagnostics not compiled into normal Iris firmware

GPIO_INSPECT.assertion: GPIO diagnostics not compiled into normal Iris firmware

GPIO_PULL_TEST.assertion: GPIO diagnostics not compiled; never sweep attached hardware
